title: The 11 Best Toaster Ovens Under $100
metaDescription: Our 11 picks for toaster ovens under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at toaster ovens under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Easy Reach 4-Slice Toaster Oven with Roll-Top Door
products.blurb: Key specs: 1300W with roll-top door instead of a swing-down door, 4-slice / 0.4 cubic foot cavity fits a 9-inch pizza, Toast, bake, and broil functions with analog dials.
strengths: Roll-top door eliminates dripping grease or food sliding off a hot drop-down door
Compact footprint fits counters where a standard swing-door oven can't
Simple analog controls with no learning curve for toast and reheating
limitations: No convection fan, a basic radiant-heat design, so browning is less even than convection models
0.4 cubic foot cavity is too small for a 12-inch pizza or a 9x13 pan
No digital timer precision, just a mechanical dial
